packageRules.description: The benchmark trees pin their tools on purpose (each manifest says so) and are bumped by hand when the benchmark is rerun. Renovate also cannot write the tailwind-compare lockfile (EALLOWREMOTE on a remote wasm tarball).
@types/node follows the oldest Node the packages support (engines), not the newest, so the typecheck catches an API older Nodes lack. Raise it with the engines floor (22 at 4.0).

The repository's own Stylelint is the version the local gate runs on: 17, which most users have (46% of weekly downloads on 2026-11-05, 18 at 0.2%). CI covers 16.7, 16, 17 and 18. stylelint-plugin-logical-css, an optional peer tested here, also still caps its peer at 17. Lift this when 18 passes 17's share or 4.0 moves the floor.
